metadata.title: Pass 3 reference table for the moving-boundary P1 finite-element limb-bud outgrowth mesh coupled to the Raspopovic et al. (2014) Bmp-Sox9-Wnt network
metadata.created_by: MorphoEval Autonomous Loop slot-016 Pass 3 (Claude Fable 5.1)
metadata.caveat: Every reference value in this table is either (a) an analytic consequence of the Raspopovic et al. (2014) baseline parameters (dispersion relation, Lean Laws 4-6 in morphoeval/lean/loops/Loop_016_bmp_sox9_wnt_digits.lean) or (b) a qualitative statement reported in the cited papers. No value is a digitised measurement of a limb-bud growth curve; see `not_vendored`.
not_vendored: Measured mouse limb-bud outgrowth kinetics (length vs stage) from Boehm et al. (2010) / Marcon et al. (2011) - the growth law R(t) = min(R1, R0 exp(g t)) is a declared reduction
A realistic bud outline: the mesh is a polar fan with uniform radial stretch
The Raspopovic et al. (2014) supplementary growth maps and their FGF/Hox parameter-modulation functions

sources.role: 3-node network, FGF/Hox wavelength modulation keeps Sox9 stripes unbranched on the growing autopod (Fig. 4)
digit number scales with autopod width / Hox-controlled wavelength
reaction-diffusion on growing domains: dilution term -(div u) c, frequency-doubling / sequential mode insertion
finite-element limb-bud growth model; proliferation gradient alone insufficient for bud shape
computational growth map of the mouse limb bud used by Raspopovic et al. (2014) for the growing-domain simulations
digital arch: marginal digits condense last (qualitative order of digit formation)

mesh.element: P1 linear triangle, lumped mass, implicit diffusion, explicit reaction
mesh.physical_map: r = r_prox + (R(t) - r_prox) xi ; theta = theta_max eta
mesh.boundary_condition: zero flux on all four edges (natural FEM boundary condition)
mesh.growth_law: R(t) = min(R1, R0 exp(g t)) ; uniform radial Lagrangian stretch
mesh.length_unit: lambda_c(q_c = 1.5700) = 4.002 of the Raspopovic et al. (2014) baseline dispersion relation

bifurcation_range_with_modulation.source: raspopovic2014 Fig. 4: with the distal FGF/Hox gradient the Sox9 stripes remain unbranched

bifurcation_range_without_modulation.source: raspopovic2014 Fig. 4 / supplementary: without the gradient the stripes bifurcate as the arc widens

expected_outcomes.final_arc_sweep_source: floor(L_arc / lambda_AER) with lambda_AER = 4.00 (Lean Law 5); digit number proportional to autopod width is the Sheth et al. (2012) observation

sequential_addition_events_default_run.source: floor(20.06/4.00) - floor(11.94/4.00) = 5 - 2 admissible insertions, of which the model realises 3 -> 4 -> 5 after onset (analytic)
